sources.title: Consistency Models (Song et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The source defines Consistency Models: self-consistent function f mapping any PF-ODE trajectory point to origin (boundary f(x,eps)=x) via EDM-style skip parameterisation reusing diffusion UNets; consistency distillation from a teacher ODE solver or isolated consistency training from data; one-step sampling plus multistep alternate-denoise/inject schedule; zero-shot denoise/interpolation/inpainting/colourisation/SR/SDEdit.

Reported numbers: distilled CIFAR-10 1-step FID 3.55, 2-step 2.93 SOTA; ImageNet-64 1-step 6.20, 2-step 4.70; isolated CT matches progressive distillation without teacher and beats non-adversarial one-step methods and many GANs.

limitations.text: Needs Lipschitz + higher-order solver for theorem error rates; continuous-time needs forward-mode JVP; greedy tau search assumes unimodal FID.
